title: GrayBox
tagline: Decentralized File Storage with/without Encryption and Access Control
description:
Centralized cloud storage poses vulnerabilities to the data that is stored. From large organizations to private individuals, millions have had their data compromised. Other issues with centralized data storage may be ransomware attacks or cloud infrastructure failures that prevent access to the stored data (Eg: The recent AIIMS Ransomware hack that shifted the hospital to complete manual mode).  GrayBox aims to solve this problem by providing a decentralized cloud storage solution for users and organizations that is simple to use and have peace of mind for their data.

IPFS files are public and open, but our application provides a Dashboard for people to see and maintain their Encrypted and Open files along with a Sharing feature to other Wallet addresses.
